deep.reconstruction:
The page is a short private money calculation, a currency conversion followed by a statement of how the sum is paid. It has no mathematical research content.

Line 1: '1000 fl im 24 fl Fuß ist im 20 fl Fuß Rthlr 555 — 20 mgr.'
- The 24-fl-Fuß (Rhenish/South German standard) strikes 24 gulden from one Cologne mark of fine silver. The 20-fl-Fuß (Conventionsfuß) strikes 20 gulden from the same mark.
- So 1000 fl (24-fl-Fuß) contain 1000/24 = 125/3 marks of fine silver.
- In the 20-fl-Fuß that silver is (125/3)·20 = 2500/3 = 833 1/3 fl.
- In the Conventionsfuß 1 Reichsthaler = 1½ fl, so the sum is (2500/3)/(3/2) = 5000/9 = 555 5/9 Rthlr. (These intermediate steps are mine.)
- With 1 Rthlr = 36 Mariengroschen (mgr), 5/9 Rthlr = 20 mgr. Result: 555 Rthlr 20 mgr, as written.

Lines 2–5 (payment): 'dafür ... anbei' – roughly 'for this there are enclosed':
- 21 Louis d'or at 5 Rthlr 14 mgr each: 21·(5 + 14/36) = 105 + 294/36 = 113 Rthlr 6 mgr.
- 'Münze' (silver coin), the remainder: 442 Rthlr 14 mgr.
- Sum: 113 Rthlr 6 mgr + 442 Rthlr 14 mgr = 555 Rthlr 20 mgr. This equals the converted amount.

In effect Gauss converts a 1000-gulden sum from the Rhenish standard into Conventionsgeld thaler. He then records a settlement made partly in gold (Louis d'or at an agio rate) and partly in silver coin. This is household or business bookkeeping.

results.what: Conversion of 1000 fl from the 24-gulden standard to the 20-gulden (Conventions) standard, expressed in Reichsthaler and Mariengroschen: 5000/9 Rthlr = 555 Rthlr 20 mgr
Payment split: 21 Louis d'or at 5 Rthlr 14 mgr = 113 Rthlr 6 mgr, plus 442 Rthlr 14 mgr in silver coin, totalling 555 Rthlr 20 mgr

deep.surprise_reason: This is a private financial note: a coinage-standard conversion and a payment tally. It has no mathematical novelty. Gauss's careful handling of money matters (his own finances, the Göttingen widows' fund) is well known.

checkable.asserts: 1000 fl in the 24-fl standard equal 5000/9 Reichsthaler in the 20-fl standard (1 Rthlr = 1.5 fl)
The fractional part 5/9 Rthlr equals 20 Mariengroschen (36 mgr per Rthlr)
21 Louis d'or at 5 Rthlr 14 mgr each make 113 Rthlr 6 mgr
Gold part plus silver part equals the total of 555 Rthlr 20 mgr

transcription_corrections: 'Rß' is the Reichsthaler sign (Rthlr), and 'mg' is Mariengroschen (mgr).
'5ʃ' is '5 Rthlr', written with the thaler symbol: 'à 5 Rthlr 14 mgr'.
'Mtze' is most likely 'Münze' (silver coin, as opposed to the gold Louis d'or).
'fl fuß' should read 'fl Fuß' (coinage standard), and 'ist in' should read 'ist im'.
'dafür kann[?] anbei[?]' is uncertain. 'dafür kommen anbei' or 'dafür dann anbei' ('for which enclosed') fit the sense.
